payload.title: codex parity
payload.body: Bring the codex projection to parity with claude and omp. Seen in the 0.3.0 verification: codex has no preload field, so skills reach its agents only as a required-reading list with relative paths (skills/<name>/SKILL.md, no anchor to ~/.codex); its session variables for the memory shim are inherited from claude's, marked unmeasured in forge, and a memory call with none set mints a fresh session instead of refusing; and this host's codex deployment predates 0.3.0 (no note skill, no design or plan scripts). A follow-up for later, not now.
